''See also: [[Enosh Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Enosh is a free city characterized by its golden walls and a layout consisting of four quarters surrounding a central [[Grandmasters' palace]]. The city is home to a population of [[Travelers]], who are known for their ability to maintain territories, secure roads, and manage waystations. While some view the city as a cult centered around [[Incarnations]] that poses a threat to the world, others see it as a place of refuge with fresh air and organized streets. A prophecy exists stating that a [[Traveler]] from the [[City of Light]], [[Elysia]], will return to lead Enosh in a conflict against the [[King of Damasca]]. Despite its historical utility as a trading partner and stabilizer for regional territories, Enosh has become a target of war. The [[King of Damasca]] intends to destroy the city using various weapons and allies, viewing its recent acquisition of an [[Incarnation]] as a reason to shift from profitable coexistence to total [[destruction]].}}

== House of Blades ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-01-house-of-blades|Located to the west of [[Myria]], Enosh is a free city that serves as a home for [[Travelers]]. The city provides essential supplies and medical care, with its [[Grandmasters]] residing in a palace situated at the exact center of the settlement. While patrols from the city extend to the south, the local heretics do not worship the Evening [[Star]]. Enosh eventually becomes a destination for [[Alin]] and [[Leah]] as the city gathers for war behind their Rising Sun.}}

== The Crimson Vault ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|Enosh is an aggressive cult of the [[Incarnations]] located near [[Myria]] that controls [[Naraka waypoints]] through its [[Grandmasters]]. This city, which features a palace and a council-room, is protected by walls that a golem army could shatter and maintains a soldier force nearly equal in size to [[Leah]]'s group. Following a battle with the [[Travelers]] [[Indirial]], preparations for war were made as the King intended to crush the territory. During these events, [[Simon]] occupied a suite of rooms within the city, while [[Alin]] was practically conscripted and [[Leah]] was left behind after planting a crystal. The location also served as the site where [[Grandmaster Naraka]] was brought and where [[Talos]] deployed a strike force.}}

== City of Light ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Enosh is a walled city being reconstructed to mirror the layout of [[Elysia]], featuring streets where corpses are left and districts that provide assistance to [[Alin]]. While [[Alin]] seeks to protect the city and its fearful citizens, [[Zakareth]] intends to crush it, and the King plans to lead the nine Territories in an assault. The city serves as a location for an [[Incarnation]] and the [[Successor]], though [[Simon]] believes the site is already lost. Despite its [[Violet District]] and its role as a source of students for [[Elysia]], the city faces potential collapse from threats like the [[Ragnarus Incarnation]] and the echoing cackle of [[Grandmaster Naraka]].}}
